question: 买过Rock但从未买过Jazz的客户有哪些？返回客户编号，按编号升序，不重复。
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.customer_id FROM invoice i JOIN invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=il.track_id JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id=t.genre_id WHERE g.name='Rock' AND i.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT i2.customer_id FROM invoice i2 JOIN invoice_line il2 ON il2.invoice_id=i2.invoice_id JOIN track t2 ON t2.track_id=il2.track_id JOIN genre g2 ON g2.genre_id=t2.genre_id WHERE g2.name='Jazz') ORDER BY i.customer_id;
pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id FROM customer AS c JOIN invoice AS i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN invoice_line AS il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN track AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN genre AS g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id FROM customer AS c JOIN invoice AS i ON c.customer_id = i.invoice_id JOIN invoice_line AS il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN track AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN genre AS g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Jazz' ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 1000
